title: Glob
description: Find files by glob pattern. Uses the workspace root as the base. Returns matching file paths sorted by modification time (most recent first).

pattern.description: Glob pattern (e.g. 'src/**/*.ts', '*.{json,yaml}', 'docs/**/*.md'). Supports ** for recursive matching.

path.description: Base directory for the glob. Default: workspace root. Must be inside the workspace.
